instruction.thesis: The PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH contrarian long thesis required the elevated P/C ratio (1.465) to mean-revert as put buyers were squeezed out. After 15 snapshots (~15 hours), oil_wti_spot has moved from 96.93 to 96.81, a -0.12% move against the long, and oil_cl_pc_ratio remains unchanged at 1.465 — the signal has not resolved. The P/C ratio has shown no compression, indicating the put-heavy positioning is persistent rather than exhausted. With the position at -0.2% and the signal evidence showing no progress toward the thesis (P/C flat, spot slightly lower), the contrarian setup has not triggered the expected reversal within a reasonable window. Closing to preserve capital for cleaner setups.
